notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap for at least enough mana to activate your blink effect.
description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to activate Emiel the Blessed.
Pay the mana cost to activate Emiel the Blessed, blinking another creature you control.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
